mapper.select: select drt.id, drt.timestamp, drt.device_id, drt.target_batch, drt.target_id, drt.protocol_type, drt.frame_count, drt.search_direction, drt.search_cycle, drt.pulse_group_number, drt.total_target_count, drt.valid_target_count, drt.is_active, drt.snr, drt.`range`, drt.azimuth2, drt.pitch, drt.speed, drt.altitude, drt.target_lat, drt.target_lon, drt.target_type, drt.selection_flag, drt.x_speed, drt.y_speed, drt.z_speed, drt.is_delete from data_radar_target drt where drt.target_batch = #{targetBatch} and drt.target_id = #{targetId} and (drt.is_delete = 0 or drt.is_delete is null) order by drt.timestamp desc
